Our team is driven by innovation, integrity, and sustainability. This role will support a wide range of marketing initiatives, including brand management, content creation, website and ecommerce content, product launches, marketing events, campaigns, and cross-functional projects. You’ll work closely with internal teams, external partners, and other stakeholders to bring marketing initiatives from idea to execution while keeping projects organized and on track. The ideal candidate is someone who can balance creativity with strong project management skills, is comfortable managing multiple priorities at once, and enjoys working across different areas of marketing. Key Responsibilities • Support the development and execution of Pion Power's brand and marketing initiatives across digital, retail, and customer-facing channels. • Develop and coordinate marketing content, including website copy, product content, promotional materials, sales collateral, and other brand assets. • Manage website content and marketplace channels, landing pages, FAQs, product pages, and other customer-facing materials. • Coordinate product launches, promotional campaigns, customer education initiatives, and other marketing projects from planning through execution. • Optimize product listings, PDP content, pricing information, promotions, and other marketplace assets. • Coordinate trade shows, events, sponsorships, product demonstrations, and other marketing activities. • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Operations, Customer Service, and other internal teams to coordinate marketing initiatives and ensure deliverables are completed on time. • Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, designers, and other marketing partners as needed. • Manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously, including timelines, deliverables, approvals, and follow-ups. • Conduct market and competitor research to help identify trends, opportunities, and content or campaign ideas. • Help maintain consistency across Pion Power's brand, messaging, and customer-facing materials. Qualifications • 3 years or above of experience in marketing, brand management, content marketing, or a related field. • Strong written communication and content development skills. • Experience coordinating marketing projects, campaigns, events, or product launches. • Experience with Shopify and/or ecommerce or marketplace platforms is an asset. • Familiarity with Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO best practices. • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. • Strong attention to detail and an understanding of brand consistency. • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and external partners. • Comfortable taking ownership of projects
